title: Goldkette recordings, early radio in Detroit, and touring with Kate Smith
summary: Titles recorded with Goldkette when Victor came to Detroit, Goldkette's background, first radio broadcasts, then Kate Smith's private train, her parties, and her bandleader Jack Miller and Tony Gale.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
